theme: He Calls the Stars by Name
summary: Isaiah asked who measured the oceans in His hand and marked off the sky. The nations are like a drop in a bucket to God. He brings out the stars one by one and calls each by name.

story_reel.narration: Isaiah asked some amazing questions about God. 'Who has measured the waters in the hollow of His hand? Who has marked off the sky with the width of His hand? Who has weighed the mountains on a scale and the hills in a balance?' Picture holding all the oceans of the world in the palm of your hand! That's how big God is. Isaiah said, 'The nations are like a drop in a bucket to Him, like dust on a scale.' Even the most powerful kingdoms in the world are tiny next to God. Then Isaiah asked, 'Who can you compare God to? What can you make that looks like Him?' People in Isaiah's day made idols out of wood, silver, and gold. They had to make sure their idols wouldn't tip over! But the real God sits above the circle of the earth, and people look like grasshoppers to Him. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain. Then Isaiah said, 'Lift up your eyes and look up high. Who created all these stars? He leads them out one by one, like an army, and He calls each one by name. Because of His great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing.' God knows every star by name. And He knows your name too.

scenes.art_direction: A giant, gentle hand of light holding all the world's oceans like a puddle.

scenes.caption: Weighing the mountains
scenes.art_direction: Mountains on a scale, perfectly balanced.

scenes.caption: A drop in a bucket
scenes.art_direction: A huge empire map shrinking into a single water droplet.

scenes.art_direction: A carved idol wobbling and needing to be propped up; comedic beat.

scenes.caption: Grasshoppers below
scenes.art_direction: A view from high above the earth; people as tiny as grasshoppers, lovingly watched.

scenes.caption: Calling the stars by name
scenes.art_direction: Stars appearing one by one, each with a tiny glowing name tag.

memory_verse.text: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh, who names every star, knows my name too.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God calls every star by name. Go outside tonight (with a grown-up) and look at the sky. What do you want to say to the God who made it?

quiz.question: What did Isaiah say God measures in the hollow of His hand?
quiz.explanation: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand?

quiz.question: What are the nations like to God?
quiz.explanation: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket.

quiz.question: What does God do with the stars?
options: He calls each one by name
quiz.explanation: He calls them all by name. By the greatness of his might... not one is lacking.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You hold the oceans in Your hand and call every star by name. Thank You that You know my name too. You are so big, and You care about me! Amen.

companion.message: When I lived in the Persian palace, I'd look up at the stars at night and remember: the God who knows every star knew me, even far from home.
